# Cold Email Sequence
# Load these into Instantly.ai as a campaign sequence
# Sending schedule: Email 1 → Day 0 | Email 2 → Day 3 | Email 3 → Day 7

---

## HOW PERSONALIZATION WORKS

Before loading into Instantly.ai, each email uses two types of variables:

**Standard merge tags** (Instantly.ai fills automatically):
- `{{first_name}}` — prospect's first name
- `{{company_name}}` — their business name
- `{{city}}` — their city

**Claude-generated lines** (generated by n8n + Claude API before upload):
- `{{custom_line_1}}` — a 1-sentence observation about their specific business
- `{{pain_stat}}` — a niche-specific statistic relevant to their industry

### Generating custom_line_1 with Claude (n8n step before campaign upload)

Add this n8n node before the Apollo → Instantly upload step:

```
Prompt to Claude API:
"Write a single sentence (under 20 words) that makes a specific, believable observation
about a [BUSINESS_TYPE] in [CITY] named [BUSINESS_NAME]. 
It should reference something realistic about their situation — like staffing,
after-hours calls, or busy seasons. Sound like you noticed it, not like you researched it.
No compliments. No 'I' at the start.
Examples:
- 'Dental offices in Austin are notoriously slammed in January when deductibles reset.'
- 'HVAC companies in Phoenix miss a lot of calls during the summer rush.'
- 'Real estate agents in Miami are fielding calls at all hours right now.'
Return only the sentence, nothing else."
```

Map the response to `custom_line_1` field in your Instantly lead upload.

---

## EMAIL 1 — The Hook
**Subject lines (A/B test these):**
- `missed calls, {{first_name}}?`
- `quick question about {{company_name}}`
- `your after-hours calls`
- `{{first_name}} — 30 second watch`

**Body:**
```
{{custom_line_1}}

We built an AI that answers every call to businesses like {{company_name}} — nights,
weekends, whenever your team is tied up. Books appointments live, answers FAQs,
follows up with leads automatically.

Here's a 3-minute demo of what it sounds like for a {{business_type}} in {{city}}:
[LOOM_DEMO_LINK]

Worth a look?

— [YOUR_NAME]
[AGENCY_NAME]
```

**Why this works:**
- Subject is lowercase and curiosity-driven — looks like a colleague, not a vendor
- Opening line is specific to them, not generic
- No pitch in the first line — leads with observation
- One clear CTA: watch the demo
- Short enough to read in 10 seconds

---

## EMAIL 2 — The Social Proof Follow-Up
**Send:** 3 days after Email 1, only if no reply
**Subject lines:**
- `re: missed calls, {{first_name}}`  ← thread reply format (highest open rate)
- `what [similar business] said after 30 days`
- `{{first_name}}, one more thing`

**Body:**
```
Wanted to follow up in case the timing wasn't right.

We recently set this up for a {{business_type}} similar to {{company_name}}.
In the first 30 days:
- 94 calls answered after hours that would have gone to voicemail
- 31 new appointments booked automatically
- 0 additional staff hired

The whole thing runs itself — they check a dashboard once a week to see the numbers.

Still happy to show you what it looks like specifically for {{company_name}}:
[BOOKING_LINK]

Takes 15 minutes. No obligation.

— [YOUR_NAME]
```

**Why this works:**
- Re: subject creates thread feel — open rates 30–40% higher
- Specific numbers feel real (adjust these once you have actual client data)
- "0 additional staff hired" hits the cost-anxiety objection pre-emptively
- CTA shifts from watching a video to booking a call — warmer ask after 3 days

---

## EMAIL 3 — The Breakup
**Send:** 7 days after Email 1, only if no reply to either
**Subject lines:**
- `closing the loop, {{first_name}}`
- `should I stop reaching out?`
- `last one from me`

**Body:**
```
{{first_name}},

I'll keep this short — last email from me on this.

If after-hours calls, lead follow-up, or missed appointments aren't a problem
at {{company_name}} right now, totally understand.

If they are, and the timing just wasn't right — here's the demo link one more time:
[LOOM_DEMO_LINK]

And if you ever want to see it live, our calendar is always open:
[BOOKING_LINK]

Either way, good luck this [season/quarter].

— [YOUR_NAME]
```

**Why this works:**
- "Breakup" emails get a 2–3× higher reply rate than follow-up emails
- Removes pressure completely — which paradoxically increases response
- "If they are" re-qualifies without being pushy
- Seasonal personalization makes it feel timely

## REPLY HANDLING (Automated via GHL + n8n)

Configure Instantly.ai to push replies to n8n webhook, then:

### If reply contains positive signals ("interested", "tell me more", "what's the cost", "let's talk"):
→ Claude classifies as POSITIVE
→ n8n triggers Retell AI to call them within 10 minutes
→ GHL contact updated to "Hot Lead" stage
→ Instantly.ai pauses all future emails to that contact

### If reply contains "not interested" / "unsubscribe" / "remove me":
→ Claude classifies as OPT-OUT
→ Contact immediately removed from all sequences
→ Tagged DNC in GHL
→ Never contacted again

### If reply contains a question (pricing, how it works, timeline):
→ Claude drafts a personalized answer
→ n8n sends it via Gmail (not Instantly — personal feel)
→ Includes booking link at the end
→ Retell AI calls 2 hours later if no response to the answer

### If reply is out-of-office:
→ Wait until the return date + 1 day
→ Resume sequence from Email 2

## INSTANTLY.AI CAMPAIGN SETTINGS

```
Campaign name: [Niche] — [City] — [Date]
Daily sending limit: 40 emails/day per mailbox (ramp up from 20)
Sending window: 8am–5pm prospect's local time
Minimum time between emails: 45 minutes
Stop sequence on reply: YES
Stop sequence on booking: YES (via webhook)
Track opens: YES
Track clicks: YES (this is what triggers the Loom/n8n workflow)
Unsubscribe link: YES (required legally)
```

---

## EMAIL ACCOUNT SETUP (Critical for deliverability)

### Domain setup
1. Buy secondary domain: `[yourname]-ai.com` or `[agencyname]hq.com`
2. Set up Google Workspace on it ($6/user/month)
3. DNS records to add (your domain registrar):

```
SPF:   v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all
DKIM:  Set up in Google Workspace Admin → Apps → Gmail → Authenticate email
DMARC: v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@[yourdomain].com
```

4. Connect to Instantly.ai → Settings → Email Accounts → Add
5. Enable Instantly.ai warmup immediately (leave running permanently)
6. Do NOT send real campaigns for 14 days

### Warmup targets (Instantly.ai built-in warmup)
- Week 1–2: Warmup only, 0 campaign emails
- Week 3: Start at 20 campaign emails/day
- Week 4+: Ramp to 40/day

## NICHE-SPECIFIC EMAIL VARIANTS

### Dental offices
```
custom_line_1 examples:
"Dental offices lose an average of 3–5 new patient calls a week to voicemail."
"Most dental practices miss 30% of their calls — usually the ones at 5:05pm."
"New patient calls in the evening are the ones that go to your competitor."

pain_stat: "The average missed new patient call costs a dental practice $2,400 in lifetime value."
```

### Real estate agents
```
custom_line_1 examples:
"The [city] market is moving fast enough that a 10-minute response gap costs you the lead."
"Real estate leads in [city] go cold in under 5 minutes if they don't hear back."
"Agents in [city] are fielding calls at 9pm from buyers who just drove past a listing."

pain_stat: "78% of buyers work with the first agent who responds (NAR, 2024)."
```

### HVAC / Plumbing
```
custom_line_1 examples:
"[City] summers mean your phones are ringing before you've finished your coffee."
"Home service companies in [city] miss their highest-value jobs after 6pm."
"Emergency calls are your best jobs — and the ones most likely to go to voicemail."

pain_stat: "The average missed emergency service call is worth $800 in lost revenue."
```

### Med Spas
```
custom_line_1 examples:
"Most med spa leads come from Instagram at 10pm — and expect a response by morning."
"[City] has more med spas than ever, and the ones responding first are winning."
"Social ad leads for aesthetics practices go cold overnight if no one follows up."

pain_stat: "Med spa leads contacted within 5 minutes convert at 9× the rate of those contacted after an hour."
```

## CAMPAIGN TRACKING (What to monitor weekly)

| Metric | Target | Action if below |
|--------|--------|----------------|
| Open rate | >40% | A/B test subject lines |
| Click rate (demo link) | >8% | Rewrite email body |
| Reply rate | >3% | Adjust tone, more specific opening |
| Positive reply rate | >1% | Test new niches or cities |
| Call triggered per 100 emails | 2–4 | Check n8n webhook |
| Call → booked/closed | 25–40% | Update Retell AI knowledge base |
